alex.tan: Inc-512 postmortem actions: quick sweep — who owns the "kv-cache eviction" rollback and what's the ETA? Collecting due dates for the 3 cross-team items. @tara.nguyen @ben.singh

incident-bot: Incident Inc-512 postmortem created. Actions detected: 1) kv-cache rollback (owner: TBD) 2) canary cutover checklist (owner: infra-eng) 3) alert tuning (owner: TBD). Please update with owners + due dates.

tara.nguyen: I can own the kv-cache rollback. Targeting 2024-11-15 EOD. Will need infra help for the canary window and a dry-run pairing. @infra-eng

ben.singh: I'll take alert tuning. I'll open a PR today with proposed thresholds and dashboards. ETA 2024-11-10. @samir can you validate the query windows?

samir: @ben.singh yep, I can validate. Share the metric names and I'll run the historical queries. Also @infra-eng can we get a 1h canary slot next week (11/14) to validate the rollback behavior?

infra-eng: Tentatively provisioned 2024-11-14 03:00-04:00 UTC for a canary slot. Need final cutover checklist from Alex/Tara by 2024-11-13 to lock the window.

alex.tan: Thanks. Tara — can you post the rollback runbook snippet here? e.g.
```
# rollback steps
1) revert deployment tag
2) flush kv-cache on nodes
3) monitor 5xx rate <= 0.5% for 30m
```
I'll draft the full checklist and owners, and update the postmortem doc by 2024-11-12.

tara.nguyen: Runbook posted: https://redwood.example/doc/inc-512/rollback. Confirming 11/15 EOD for the rollback. I'll pair with Alex for a dry-run on 2024-11-13.

alex.tan: Great — I'll mark owners in the postmortem and ping PM to adjust the release calendar. Closing this sweep: if anyone needs to change dates, reply here so we can adjust the canary booking. :thumbsup:
